tagline: STRATEGIC FINANCE  ·  FP&A & LIQUIDITY  ·  AUDIT & CONTROLS  ·  TURNAROUND  ·  OPERATIONS
profile: Finance and operations executive who stabilizes, restructures, and scales mission-driven, regulated, and service-based organizations. Leads FP&A, budgeting, treasury, cash-flow forecasting, audit readiness, and internal controls across multi-entity and publicly funded environments, including GAAP, Uniform Guidance, and fund-accounting frameworks. Reversed a $1M operating deficit into a 13% operating surplus, recovered $1.5M+ in tax savings, and structured $10M+ in new government and institutional contracts. Trusted partner to CEOs and Boards on long-range planning, risk, capital strategy, and growth, with hands-on depth in ERP/CRM systems, KPI dashboards, and team development.

bullets.text: Lead financial planning, budgeting, treasury, liquidity management, and cash-flow forecasting for client organizations across nonprofit, private, education, and public-sector settings.
Direct audit readiness and external audit processes; ensure GAAP and Uniform Guidance compliance; design internal controls and fund-accounting frameworks.
Execute financial turnarounds, forensic accounting, historical clean-up, and audit remediation for organizations with reporting deficiencies.
Identified and recovered $1.5M+ in tax savings through detailed financial analysis and correction of reporting deficiencies.
Spearhead liquidity and working-capital strategy, including covenant monitoring, short-term financing analysis, and stress testing; support capital allocation through scenario modeling.
Structured the financial framework for a NYPA Clean Energy Workforce Program, aligning public funding, compliance, and performance metrics.

Negotiated and structured $10M+ in new government, institutional, and corporate contracts.
Partnered with the CEO and Board on long-range planning, risk management, and organizational growth strategy.
Developed revenue-generating social ventures that combined financial sustainability with mission outcomes.
Directed financial controls, billing, and compliance for NYCHA and NYC Department of Homeless Services contracts.
Renegotiated vendor and logistics agreements, reducing costs 35% and improving margins.
Implemented a redesigned ERP-based warehouse management system, improving processing efficiency 60% and data visibility.
